thread:
Maria S: quick handshake — I captured a short nsys run (batch=6, seq=1024) that shows interleaved KV cache misses and an odd torch.profiler allocation spike. can someone take a look before i upload full traces?
Akshay: drop the model name and exact commit? helps me repro locally.
Maria S: model: redwood-owl-3b-quant, commit: a1f3b2d, input seed in gist, perf variance pretty consistent across 3 runs.
Lena: i can eyeball the nsys flamegraph today. want the raw .qdrep or a subset?
Maria S: raw .qdrep plus the torch.profiler chrome trace would be ideal. attaching the short capture command i used:
```
nsys profile -o /tmp/run1 --sample=none --trace=cuda,osrt --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --capture-range-begin=1 --capture-range-end=200 \
  python -m torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 run_infer.py --model redwood-owl-3b-quant --batch 6 --seq_len 1024
```
Akshay: nice, can you also include the model config and the kv cache warmup script? sometimes mismatch in prefill vs generation causes extra memcpy.
Maria S: yup, i'll attach config.json and the warmup snippet. quick note: the kv pattern looks like interleaved prefill/generate calls from client side, not fused in a single session. might be a client bug.
Jon: if it's client interleaving, we should correlate request ids. do you have the request ids in the logs?
Maria S: i redacted PII, but left request ids: r-983, r-984, r-985 in the trace.
perf-bot: Reminder: before uploading traces to s3, run `scripts/profile/redact_trace.sh` to scrub env vars and IPs. Also check the upload path: s3://redwood-perf/profiles/2955012345/
Lena: when you upload, please mark which run is the baseline vs regression. makes bisecting easier. :thumbsup:
Maria S: uploaded short artifacts to the private bucket (link removed per policy). left a note in the S3 metadata: baseline=false, note="interleaved calls observed"
Akshay: i'll pull and run a small diff. if it's client-side, we should add a quick check in the request router to coalesce prefill/generate when possible.
Jon: pinging @platform-team -> if we decide to coalesce at routing layer, need to check compatibility with dedicated infra.
ops-bot: FYI retention for perf artifacts is 90 days unless flagged. tag with `keep:permanent` if you need longer.
Lena: initial glance at the flamegraph: the heavy kernel churn aligns with the JS-side interleave pattern you mentioned. looks like small CUDA kernel launches between KV lookups. i'll post a screenshot in a follow-up thread.
Maria S: thanks all. next steps: akshay to try local repro, lena to produce annotated flamegraph, jon to confirm request id mapping, i'll open a tiny PR with sanitized traces + perf note. i'll drop the PR link here when ready. :rocket:
Akshay: i reproduced locally with a simplified harness. filing a mini-issue with repro steps.
Maria S: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/perf/PR-421 (sanitized traces + runbook). please review when you have a minute.
Lena: reviewed the flamegraph and left comments on the PR. suggestion: try batching policy tweak + merge small prefill/generate calls.
Jon: created a quick alert in tracing to flag interleaved request patterns so we catch regressions automatically.
Maria S: awesome, thanks everyone. closing this thread once PR lands.
perf-bot: Note: CI will run the perf smoke test on the PR. expect results in ~30m.
